mapIdentity.scope: The cross-shaped model follows the 38 m east–west and 24.3 m north–south dimensions. The original sits on the site of mapped way 144655698, which contains the surviving instrument piers.

note: The Instituto’s published measurements give each observing tower diameter, roof composition and heights. The 1898 Caras y Caretas photograph records the north entrance columns, cylindrical roofs and west cupola.
